original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. After the Baal-on-Safe redesign deleted the custom governor, Treasury Steward, Wind-Down, Election and Treasury Outflow Limit features (G6, arp-93a), no config file defines a parameter for those removed features, and no spec references a GOVERNANCE.md section that describes them. Config for deleted code is an error, not documentation.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. At armada-poc integrated (c45e3fbe), config/mainnet.env exports STEWARD_BUDGET_USDC, STEWARD_BUDGET_WINDOW, OUTFLOW_USDC/ARM/ETH_WINDOW/BPS/ABSOLUTE/FLOOR and WINDDOWN_REVENUE_THRESHOLD; config/networks.ts sets defaults for the treasury outflow limits and the steward budget; config/networks.test.ts asserts these to the GOVERNANCE.md spec values. G6 (arp-93a) deleted ArmadaTreasuryGov, the Treasury Steward, ArmadaWindDown and ArmadaGovernor and removed their deploy steps, so these parameters feed no live contract. specs/CROWDFUND.md, specs/MONITORING.md, specs/OPERATIONS.md, specs/PARAMETER_MANIFEST.md and specs/REVENUE_LOCK.md reference GOVERNANCE.md sections (Treasury Steward, Wind-Down, Election, Treasury Outflow Limits) that the canonical specs/GOVERNANCE.md no longer contains.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run: grep -nE 'STEWARD_BUDGET|OUTFLOW_|WINDDOWN_REVENUE' config/mainnet.env config/networks.ts config/networks.test.ts. Run: grep -rn 'GOVERNANCE.md' specs/. Confirm no script under scripts/ reads these parameters: the governor, steward and wind-down deploy steps were removed in G6 (arp-93a).
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. For each dead parameter, measure its consumer first. Remove the parameter and any test that asserts it when no live Baal-on-Safe contract reads it. Keep and correct the citation of any parameter that still feeds a live contract. Repoint or remove the specs references to removed GOVERNANCE.md sections. No contract change is expected.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) config/mainnet.env, config/networks.ts, config/networks.test.ts; specs/CROWDFUND.md, specs/MONITORING.md, specs/OPERATIONS.md, specs/PARAMETER_MANIFEST.md, specs/REVENUE_LOCK.md.
restatement: After the Baal-on-Safe redesign (G6, arp-93a) deleted the custom governor, Treasury Steward, Wind-Down, Election and Treasury Outflow Limit features, no config file may define a parameter for those features. No spec may cite a GOVERNANCE.md section that describes them. Config for deleted code is an error. The dead parameters are STEWARD_BUDGET_USDC, STEWARD_BUDGET_WINDOW, OUTFLOW_USDC/ARM/ETH_WINDOW/BPS/ABSOLUTE/FLOOR and WINDDOWN_REVENUE_THRESHOLD. They must go from config/mainnet.env, config/networks.ts and config/networks.test.ts. The five spec files must stop citing the removed GOVERNANCE.md sections. No contract changes.

restatement_clauses.text: config/mainnet.env does not export STEWARD_BUDGET_USDC, STEWARD_BUDGET_WINDOW, OUTFLOW_USDC/ARM/ETH_WINDOW/BPS/ABSOLUTE/FLOOR or WINDDOWN_REVENUE_THRESHOLD.
config/networks.ts sets no defaults for the treasury outflow limits or the steward budget.
config/networks.test.ts asserts no value for the steward budget, outflow limit or wind-down revenue threshold parameters.

specs/CROWDFUND.md, specs/MONITORING.md, specs/OPERATIONS.md, specs/PARAMETER_MANIFEST.md and specs/REVENUE_LOCK.md do not reference GOVERNANCE.md sections for Treasury Steward, Wind-Down, Election or Treasury Outflow Limits.

goal: Remove dead governance configuration and dead spec citations left behind by the G6 deletion of the governor, steward, wind-down and outflow-limit features.
acceptance_criteria: The mainnet environment file no longer sets any steward budget, outflow limit or wind-down revenue threshold variable.
The network configuration file no longer defines steward budget or treasury outflow limit defaults.
The network configuration test no longer checks any steward budget, outflow limit or wind-down value.
None of the five spec files points to a GOVERNANCE.md section about the Treasury Steward, Wind-Down, Election or Treasury Outflow Limits.
